summary.headline: Lunar Astrology and Fixed-Star Tables
summary.text: Catalog of a Florentine astrological codex listing lunar topics including eclipses, phlebotomy, letters, ages, hidden things, enemies, land, and lunar works, followed by fixed-star calculations and tables, multiplication tables, calculatory chapters, and astrological themes. It cites a fixed-star table dated from Adam’s year 6854 (1346 CE), Persian chronology, Psellos, and a lunar eclipse of 1374.
